key_reasoning.reason: Three components change: the GitlabTool execute and output pipeline, a new GitLab image_download module (GitlabMultimodalResponse, MIME detection, bounded read, signature check), and a new shared base image_constants module that the Jira tool now imports. Base M (3 components, one tool layer), bumped for touching a shared base utility.

Closest pattern is the existing Jira tool image download. The new work adds security-sensitive aspects that pattern does not cover: a same-origin check on absolute URLs so the access token never reaches a foreign host, a streamed body capped at 5 MB, and magic-byte validation against the declared MIME. A content_and_artifact output-format change and edge-case test suites (oversized, empty, mismatched signature, extension fallback) also count toward L.

Diffstat: 7 files, 654 insertions, 5 deletions. 3 modified (gitlab tools.py, gitlab tools_vars.py, jira tools.py) and 4 new (base/image_constants.py, gitlab/image_download.py, 2 test modules) across 4 directories. In actual mode, 7 files maps to L.

The implementation reflects well-defined requirements: an explicit 5 MB limit, a fixed MIME allowlist and defined skip notices. Calibration: bundled M example epmcdme-10202 (agent with custom tool, total 15) agrees on the band. This change carries more risk but has clearer requirements.
